headlines.summary_en: Nohshad Shah, head of fixed income sales for EMEA at Citadel Securities, said Fed Chair Kevin Warsh's pledge to control inflation without specifying how has introduced new uncertainty for investors. headlines.title: 美银：若美联储说不清如何抗通胀方案美国国债就会重拾跌势
headlines.summary: 美国银行全球研究部的美国利率策略主管Mark Cabana认为，如果美联储不能更好地告诉大众它将如何实现2%的通胀目标，美国国债的跌势就会重新出现。 上周三将收益率推至近20年高位的长债抛售是一次“教科书式的通胀公信力冲击”。当天，美联储主席凯文·沃什在记者会上未能向投资者解释央行将如何抑制价格上涨。 “你有坚定的决心实现2%的通胀是很好，但除非你告诉我们你要怎么做到，否则我们是不会相信你的，” Cabana接受彭博电视采访时说，“而且你也骗不了债券，它会看穿你。”

headlines.title_en: BofA: If Fed Can't Clarify How to Tackle Inflation, U.S. Treasuries Will Resume Decline
headlines.summary_en: Mark Cabana, head of US rates strategy at BofA Global Research, believes that if the Fed fails to better communicate to the public how it will achieve its 2% inflation target, the selloff in US Treasuries will resume. Last Wednesday's long-end bond selloff, which pushed yields to near 20-year highs, was a "textbook inflation credibility shock." That day, Fed Chair Kevin Warsh failed to explain to investors at a press conference how the central bank would curb price increases. "It's great that you're determined to achieve 2% inflation, but unless you tell us how you're going to do it, we won't believe you," Cabana said in a Bloomberg TV interview. "And you can't fool the bond market—it will see through you."

headlines.title_en: CSRC: Focus on Five Areas of Coordination to Deepen Mainland-Hong Kong Market Cooperation
headlines.summary_en: [CSRC: Focusing on Five Areas of Coordination to Deepen Mainland-Hong Kong Market Cooperation] On August 3, CSRC Chairman Wu Qing delivered remarks at the listing ceremony for RMB government bond futures in Hong Kong. Wu noted that the CSRC will focus on coordination across five areas—functions, products, ecosystem, regulation, and governance—to further roll out policy measures deepening two-way pragmatic cooperation and supporting Hong Kong capital market development. He reaffirmed support for domestic firms expanding globally to list in Hong Kong and for quality Hong Kong-listed companies to list on the mainland, jointly safeguarding the stable operation of both markets.

headlines.title_en: U.S. Treasury Raises July-September Borrowing Estimate to $739 Billion
headlines.summary_en: The US Treasury projects net marketable debt financing of $739 billion for privately held securities in the July-September 2026 quarter, assuming a $950 billion cash balance at end-September. That estimate is $68 billion higher than the May figure, mainly due to expected lower net cash inflows. The Treasury also projects $628 billion in financing for the October-December 2026 quarter, assuming an $850 billion cash balance at end-December. For the April-June 2026 quarter, the Treasury financed $190 billion, roughly in line with the $189 billion estimate published in May. Further details on the quarterly refunding will be released at 8:30 a.m. ET (8:30 p.m. Beijing time) on August 5.

headlines.title_en: U.S. Medium- and Long-Term Treasury Yields Fall More Than 4 Basis Points
headlines.summary_en: On Monday (August 3) in late New York trading, the 10-year US Treasury yield fell 4.90 basis points to 4.6857%, trading narrowly around 4.68% and hitting a daily low of 4.6674% at 20:02 Beijing time. The 2-year yield rose 3.72 basis points to 4.2518%; the 30-year yield fell 4.19 basis points to 5.2295%, remaining in a subdued narrow range. The 2/10-year yield spread narrowed 0.373 basis point to +43.185 basis points. The 10-year TIPS yield fell 2.05 basis points to 2.4265%; the 2-year TIPS yield rose 1.02 basis points to 2.0968%; the 30-year TIPS yield fell 3.19 basis points to 3.0031%.

headlines.title: 道明：干预势头可能短暂推动美元/日元跌至153
headlines.summary: 道明证券认为，干预的推动力可能会使美元/日元跌至153，但除非日本央行采取更多行动或美国财政部做出全面承诺，否则就只会暂时如此。“动能可能短暂推动美元/日元跌至153，但要没有日本央行的行动或美国财政部的全面承诺，我们不认为该货币对会大幅低于该水平，” Howard Du、Gennadiy Goldberg和Molly Brooks等策略师写道。“美日双边贸易动态、‘卖出美国’情绪复苏的风险、美国信誉恶化的风险、政治考量以及包括系统性冲击在内的风险，是我们相信美国财政部不愿全力托底日元的五大原因”。

headlines.title_en: TD: Intervention Momentum May Briefly Push USD/JPY to 153
headlines.summary_en: TD Securities believes intervention momentum could push USD/JPY to 153, but without further Bank of Japan action or a full US Treasury commitment, it would only be temporary. "Momentum could briefly push USD/JPY to 153, but absent BoJ action or a full Treasury commitment, we don't see the pair significantly below that level," strategists including Howard Du, Gennadiy Goldberg, and Molly Brooks wrote. "US-Japan bilateral trade dynamics, the risk of 'Sell America' sentiment resurging, risks of US credibility deterioration, political considerations, and risks including systemic shocks are the five reasons we believe the Treasury is reluctant to fully backstop the yen."
